MIND. [1] [Canth.]
Unconsciousness, lies with outstretched arms ; sudden starting up, screaming, throwing arms about. θ Metritis.
Sudden loss of consciousness with red face. θ Dentition.
Lies in a stupor with cold surface and occasional jerks.
Forgetfulness.
Confusion ; distraction of mind ; inability to concentrate thought.
Confusion of head and pulsation in forehead, in morning.
Furious delirium, with crying, barking and biting ; confusion of head, anxious restlessness ; cold sweat, especially on hands and feet.
Almost frenzied delirium.
Paroxysms of rage, renewed by sight of dazzling, bright objects, or touching larynx when trying to drink water.
Whining and complaining, with anxious restlessness, < from motion, > lying quiet.
Despondent and low-spirited, says she must die.
Fear, confusion of ideas, she could not think clearly. θ Vesical hemorrhoids.
Great amativeness ; amorous frenzy.
Unbounded frantic sexual desire. θ Mania.
Exceedingly sensitive to all impressions ; irritable and blaspheming. θ Traumatic neuralgia.
Insolent and contradictory mood, in afternoon.
Anxious restlessness, ending in rage.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Canth.]
Heaviness of head.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Canth.]
Burning in sides of head, ascending from neck, with soreness and giddiness ; < morning and afternoon ; when standing or sitting ; > while walking or lying down.
Painful tearing on vertex, with sensation as if some one was pulling a lock of hair upward.
Violent lancinating pains deep in brain, especially in occiput. θ Cerebro-spinal meningitis.
Heaviness in occiput, with drowsiness and incapacity to think.
Headache from washing or bathing.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Canth.]
Hair falls out when combing. θ During confinement or lactation.
Scales on scalp ; enormous dandruff.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Canth.]
Objects look yellow.
Eyes look yellow.
Burning in eyes and glowing heat, as from coals.
Biting sensation, as of salt in eyes.
Smarting in eyes.
Lachrymation in open air ; must close eyes ; on opening lids, margins pain as if sore, like raw flesh.
Inflammation of eyes, particularly when caused by a burn.
Eyes protruding ; fiery, sparkling, staring look.
Eyes sunken, surrounded by blue rings.
Eyes restlessly in motion, at times staring, always, however, with a frightful look ; pupils contracted. θ Acute mania.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Canth.]
Ringing, humming, or roaring in ears.
Tearing in right ear right mastoid process, as if bone would be torn out.
A hot exhalation passes, at intervals, and frequently, out from ears.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Canth.]
Erysipelatous inflammation of dorsum of nose, spreading to both cheeks, but more to right ; followed by desquamation.
Secretion of much tenacious mucus from nose, without sneezing ; hoarseness and painful hawking of tough mucus from chest ; nightly dry cutting stitches along trachea, externally.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Canth.]
Expression of extreme suffering, terror or despair.
Deathlike look during and after the pains.
Face : hot, red and swollen ; swollen and puffy ; flushed when stooping ; yellow, or very pale.
Face fallen in ; cheeks bluish. θ Acute mania.
Erysipelas beginning on dorsum of nose and spreading to cheeks, more to right.
   

LOWER FACE. [9] [Canth.]
Dry lips without thirst.
The jaws tightly closed, almost approaching trismus, especially when they wished to give her water or medicine, which she prevented by angrily tossing about. θ Acute mania.
   

TEETH AND GUMS. [10] [Canth.]
Grinding teeth. θ Meningitis. θ Typhus.
Gums spongy and swollen. θ Suppurative metritis.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Canth.]
Taste : bitter ; lost ; gold tooth-plate tastes coppery.
Speech weak and timorous.
Trembling of tongue.
Tongue fiery red. θ Facial erysipelas.
Tongue : thickly furred, red at edges ; swollen and thickly coated ; and back of mouth, in part excoriated, in part covered with blisters.
Inflammation of tongue with vesicles.
Sublingual glands swollen with vesicles.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Canth.]
Mucous membrane red and covered with small blisters.
Loss of epithelium on lips, tongue and palate. θ Dysentery.
Burning pain in mouth, throat and stomach.
Vesicles and cankers in mouth and throat. θ Dysentery.
Lining of mouth and throat covered with white blisters from size of pin's head to that of a bean.
Salivation : copious ; tasteless ; disgustingly sweet.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Canth.]
Mucus in posterior nares must be hawked into mouth to be discharged.
Burning sensation in throat, which feels as if on fire.
Burning in throat, with scraped sensation and spitting of blood.
Spasmodic constriction and intense pain at back of throat.
Throat inflamed and covered with plastic lymph.
Aphthous ulcer at back part of fauces, covered with a whitish adherent crust ; a similar one on right tonsil.
Swallowing very difficult. θ Tonsillitis.
Difficult deglutition with nocturnal regurgitation.
Water drunk regurgitates through nose. θ Sequel of burn.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Canth.]
Diminished appetite.
Great thirst, with burning pain in throat and stomach.
Thirst, with aversion to all fluids.
Disgust for everything ; drink, food and tobacco.
   

EATING AND DRINKING. [15] [Canth.]
After drinking coffee, sensation of fulness.
Drinking even small quantities of water, increases pain in bladder.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Canth.]
Empty eructations ; eructations of sour, frothy mucus, tinged bright red.
Nausea and vomiting.
Vomiting : of water drunk, also of blood ; greenish, offensive ; of bile and ingesta ; of frothy mucus, tinged bright red.
Vomiting, with violent retching and severe colic. θ Pregnancy.
Vomiting of bile. θ Phrenitis.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Canth.]
Acute pain in region of stomach and bladder, with such exquisite sensibility that slightest pressure produces convulsions.
Violent burning pain in stomach.
Burning in region of pylorus.
Pressure in scrobiculum after eating.
Sensation of fulness, extending to chest and abdomen, after taking coffee.
Nightly regurgitation of food.
Chronic gastritis with dysuria.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Canth.]
Incarceration of flatus under short ribs.
Right side of liver painful and sensitive. θ Yellow fever.
Splenic troubles.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Canth.]
Abdomen swollen and tympanitic above ; yields a dull sound below. θ Puerperal fever.
Great distension and tenderness in belly.
Abdomen sensitive, and burning pain about umbilicus. θ Cholera
Violent burning pain and heat through whole intestinal tract, with painful sensitiveness to touch.
Cutting in abdomen.
Sensation of great fulness in lower part of abdomen.
Cutting, stitching, or burning in groins.
Peritonitis, with burning pains in abdomen and urinary tenesmus.
Ascites.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Canth.]
No stool or urine for 48 hours. θ Acute mania.
Copious stools.
Diarrhœa of blood and mucus.
Feces red, slimy or green.
Passage of white or pale red tough mucus with stool, like scrapings from intestines, with streaks of blood.
Passage of pure blood from anus and urethra.
Before stool : straining ; urging ; colic.
During stool : cutting, colicky pains ; burning in anus ; prolapse of rectum ; pressing and urging, extorting cries.
Stool daily but insufficient, with painful straining on bladder. θ Catarrh of bladder.
After stool : colic relieved ; burning, biting and stinging in anus ; straining ; faintness ; shuddering.
Desire for stool while urinating.
Pain in perineum, seemingly arising from neck of bladder.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Canth.]
Dull pressing pains in both kidneys.
Pain in region of kidneys and urging to urinate, steadily increasing in severity.
Constant, dull painful sensation in region of kidneys, late in evenings.
Paroxysmal cutting and burning pains in both kidneys, the region very sensitive to slightest touch, alternating with pain in tip of penis ; urging to urinate ; painful evacuation, by drops, of bloody urine and, at times, of pure blood.
Dull, heavy distensive pain in region of kidney, either side, no relief in any position ; continued rolling and twisting of body, with groans and cries, resulting in nausea, retching and vomiting, unless the stomach is empty ; no great desire to urinate, but a tingling thrill running down dorsum to penis to glans. θ Renal calculus.
Very frequent painful straining, but with discharge of so small quantity that he had to be frequently catheterized, which caused terrible pain ; urine cloudy, of a somewhat bright yellow color ; after standing a little, a sediment of mucus and phosphatic salts appeared : immediately on being passed was of alkaline reaction ; some pus with the urine ; region of bladder very sensitive to pressure ; attacks of painful urination more frequent and painful at night, he slept but little. θ Catarrh of bladder.
Every two hours an attack of very painful urging to urinate, during which, with whining or groaning, a quantity of clear urine was discharged, accompanied by pressure on rectum and passage each time of a little soft, but otherwise normal stool. θ Bladder complaint in an old man.
Violent tenesmus vesicæ and strangury.
Painful discharge of a few drops of bloody urine, causing very severe sharp pain, as if a red-hot iron was passed along urethra ; this pain was most acutely felt as membranous portion of canal, and in meatus urinarius.
Cutting and contracting pains from ureters down towards penis ; at times pains pass from without inward ; pressure on glans relieves pain somewhat.
Violent burning, cutting pains in neck of bladder, extending to fossa navicularis, < before and after urinating.
Violent pains in bladder with frequent urging ; intolerable tenesmus.
Heaviness in bladder, feels sore on slightest motion.
Urging to urinate from smallest quantity of urine in bladder.
Dribbling discharge, reddish, sometimes mixed with blood.
Urging, < when standing, and still more when walking ; > when sitting.
With urging to urinate, stitching pain in forepart of neck of bladder ; on continued urging only a few drops pass.
Frequent painful urination, constantly preceded by violent pain in glans.
Ardor urinæ.
Before, during and after urinating fearful cutting pains in urethra ; she must double herself and scream from pains.
Burning, when urinating, and when not.
Urine passes in thin and divided stream. θ Stricture.
Fruitless effort to urinate.
Enuresis.
Retention of urine, causing pain. θ Suppressed gonorrhœa.
Urine contained (when finally passed) much albumen, was almost black. θ Acute mania.
Urine dark colored.
Urine : turbid and scanty ; cloudy during night, like mealy water, with white sediment ; albuminous, containing cylindrical casts ; deposits greyish-white granules.
Atony of bladder from long retention of urine.
Intense vesical spasm.
Post-scarlatinal nephritis ; threatening uræmia.
Morbus Brightii : early stage, especially when occurring from blows on loins, or sudden change of temperature.
Diabetes insipidus.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Canth.]
Sexual desire : increased ; disturbing sleep at night.
Frightful satyriasis ; violent, painful priapism, with excessive pains.
Strong and persistent erections, painless and without voluptuous sensation.
Erections at night, with contraction and sore pain along urethra.
Swelling of glans, which is very painful, even to external pressure.
Gonorrhœal phimosis.
Dropsical swelling of penis and scrotum.
Testicles drawn up.
Smegma præputii.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Canth.]
Ovarian region : stitches, arresting breathing ; violent pinching pains, with bearing down towards genitals ; great burning pain.
Inflammation of ovaries after suppressed gonorrhœa.
Pruritus : with strong sexual desire ; during climacteric period.
Violent itching in vagina.
Swelling and irritation of vulva ; vaginismus.
Inflammatory suppuration of womb with extreme tenderness.
Uterine hemorrhage, with great irritation in neck of bladder.
Menses : too early, too profuse ; blood black or scanty, breasts painful. θ Sterility.
Amenorrhœa, with fulness and pain in head.
Leucorrhœa : with sexual excitement ; in consequence of masturbation ; with prurigo.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Canth.]
Vomiting, with violent retching and severe colic ; burning at pylorus.
Puerperal convulsions : presence of bright objects ; sight, drinking, or sound of water, and touching larynx reproduce violent spasms.
Promotes fecundity ; expels moles, dead fetuses and placenta.
Retained placenta or membranes, usually with painful urination.
Burning pain ; abdomen sensitive ; peritonitis, with tenesmus of bladder.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Canth.]
Complete loss of voice ; much cough ; threw himself about in bed, from anxiety. θ Croup.
Speech very low, with sensation of weakness of vocal organs.
Voice : hoarse ; feeble and indistinct.
Burning and stinging in larynx, especially when attempting to hawk up tough mucus.
Catarrh in larger bronchia, with profuse, yellow expectoration.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Canth.]
When breathing deeply, and when speaking, she feels as if she dare not exert herself, on account of extraordinary weakness of respiratory organs ; speech therefore weak and timorous.
   

COUGH. [27] [Canth.]
Dry, hacking cough.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Canth.]
Shooting pain in chest, from front towards back, impeding respiration.
A fine stitch extending from right axilla into chest.
Stitching pain in forepart of right chest ; it then passes downward into right lower ribs.
Stitches in chest, more on right side, or first left, then right ; in lower right chest, extending towards middle of sternum.
Burning in chest.
Exudation within pleura. θ Pleurisy.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Canth.]
Anxiety in cardiac region.
Stitch in heart, followed by a crawling sensation.
Drawing pain in region of heart.
Pulse : very variable, mostly hard, full and frequent, at times intermittent ; frequent and small ; slow, feeble and scarcely perceptible ; more full and rapid in morning.
   

OUTER CHEST. [30] [Canth.]
Stitches in sternum.
Burning in chest.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Canth.]
Stiffness of neck, with tensive pain on stooping.
Tearing in cervical muscles.
Tearing pain in back, especially mornings.
Pain in loins, with incessant desire to urinate.
Pain in loins, kidneys and abdomen, with such pain on urinating that he could not pass a single drop without moaning and screaming.
Lancinations and tearing in os coccygis, causing him to start. θ Coccygodynia.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Canth.]
Tearing and stitching pains in arms.
Eczematous vesicles between fingers, itching and burning fearfully.
Eczematous eruption on dorsum of left hand, between and upon fingers ; burning, pricking, shallow vesicles filling with fluid and soon drying into thin crusts, which peeled off, leaving denuded spots ; < from cool water, > from warmth.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Canth.]
Coxalgia with spasmodic pains in bladder and strangury.
Tearing from right, later left hip bone, down to knees.
Knees totter when ascending steps.
Violent pains in knees ; sometimes boring.
Pain in soles, as from an ulcer, could not step.
Fearful pain in soles of feet, like an ulcer ; she could not step for four days.
Darting pain from right foot to right side of head in paroxysms. θ Neuralgia.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Canth.]
Weakness and trembling of limbs.
Dropsical swelling of hands and feet.
Cold sweat of hands and feet.
   

NERVES. [36] [Canth.]
Subsultus tendinum.
Weakness, prostration, faintness, general coldness, collapse. θ Diphtheria.
Convulsions, with dysuria and hydrophobic symptoms ; bright light, drink or sound of falling water, touching larynx, or painful parts, cause or renew spasm ; excessive desire for sexual intercourse.
Hemiplegia of right side with aphasia.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Canth.]
Sleeplessness ; anxious dreams ; erections.
Sleepy, but cannot sleep soundly on account of sudden twitchings. θ Sequel of a burn.
   

FEVER. [40] [Canth.]
Chill in evening, not relieved by external warmth.
Burning in palms and soles.
Burning heat at night, which patient does not feel.
Heat, with thirst.
Sweat on genitals.
Cold extremities.
Chill running up back ; succeeded by thirst without heat ; not relieved by external warmth.
Sweat smells like urine.
Sweat from every movement.
Evening fever. Catarrh of bladder.
Typhoid, with difficult and scanty urination, inability to lie on left side, palpitation and great anxiety at night, and a clot of blood comes into mouth for two or three mornings.
In third stage, when there is complete insensibility ; cramps in abdominal muscles and legs ; suppression of urine ; hemorrhages from stomach and intestines ; cold sweat on hands and feet. θ Yellow fever.
   

SENSATIONS. [43] [Canth.]
Raw and sore pain in whole body, internally and externally.
Every part oversensitive, accompanied by excessive weakness.
Darting, stinging pain on different parts of body at same time. Compare Crot. tigl.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Canth.]
Great emaciation. θ Catarrh of bladder.
Suppuration of internal organs.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Canth.]
On being touched or disturbed had violent attacks, so that it took four men to hold her. θ Acute mania.
Touching the larynx or painful parts renews symptoms. θ Spasms.
Scalds and burns. See 46.
   

SKIN. [46] [Canth.]
Ulcerative pain in skin when touched.
Erythema, from exposure to rays of sun. θ Eczema solaris.
Vesicles all over body, < between toes, which are all sore and suppurating.
Vesicular erysipelas ; blebs swell and exude much watery matter.
Erysipelatous inflammation of skin, followed by prickling.
Superficial ulcerations caused by burns, with burning pains and lachrymation.
Burns, before blisters form, and when they have formed. [Obs. Recommended by Dr. Hering as a most valuable remedy in scalds and burns. The injured part is immersed or bathed in a few drops of the tincture in water. A potency may be given inwardly. To demonstrate the truth of similia, he frequently challenged skeptics to burn their fingers and then immerse the injured members in a dilution of Cantharides. --The editors.].
Psoriasis.
Itching, changing place, like from lice.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Canth.]
A boy, æt. 6, light complexion. θ Sequel of a burn.
A woman in third month of pregnancy. θ Eczema of hands.
Woman, æt. 29, scrofulous. θ Kidney affection.
